title: Cathodic protection verification: generic historical bracelet-anode riser
scope: Independent generic installed-arrangement verification; sprayed-aluminium and bare zones. Numerical inputs remain undeclared.
interpretation: Step 1 takes the narrower reading: source and required-input specification only. It does not register a runnable case or admit a new edition.

proposed_route.current_support: unsupported; the existing edition API rejects 1993
deferred: Al-base anodes above 25 degC: defer pending separate qualification of clauses 6.6.3-6.6.4 and Figure 6.6.1, including applicability beyond heated buried pipelines; no automatic temperature-rule transfer to a riser.

source_document.document: DNV RP B401, Cathodic Protection Design
source_document.page_convention: pdf_page is one-based; use the printed page independently of other scans
source_document.verification: Source located publicly. Table-page images inspected; cell-by-cell transcription and computational qualification remain pending.
source_document.retention: Reference only; no PDF, page image, standard prose or numerical table is included in this change.

citation_contract: Each future standard-derived value records this document and edition, exact table or clause, row/column, unit and page; no later-edition fallback.

zones.applicability: DNV RP B401 (1993), clause 6.3.16, printed p. 16: qualify the 200 um nominal thermally sprayed aluminium thickness basis. This clause provides average demand only; the initial/final densities defined in clauses 6.3.1-6.3.4 do not apply. Initial/final treatment for this zone is unresolved and remains not evaluated; neither zero nor later-edition values may be substituted.

fields: yearly average surface-water temperature for climatic region (degC)
individual net metal mass excluding inserts (kg)
final exposed geometry and area (m, m2)
qualified depletion rule: decide clause 6.7.6 versus 6.7.7 using bracelet subtype and mounting evidence
required_inputs.applicability: DNV RP B401 (1993), clauses 6.7.6-6.7.7, printed p. 23: clause 6.7.6 concerns pipeline half-shells flush with concrete weight coating with mastic-filled gaps; a riser bracelet is not assumed to meet that basis. Qualify the applicable rule before selecting final exposed geometry.

input_provenance: Future geometry/count/environment choices must be independently declared generic inputs, with their declaration and derivation cited. This spec contains no numerical case vector.
acceptance: Step 1: the specification loads offline and every input/acceptance citation resolves; the edition API rejects 1993 and S12 is absent from the executable case registry.
Before implementation: qualify source cells, equations, applicability, units and proposed input-field names.
Before numerical acceptance: freeze independent generic inputs and a cited hand calculation; define scalar tolerances and exact integer-count comparison.

Verification must assess the declared installed arrangement against capacity and applicable initial/final output under clauses 7.7-7.8. The TSA zone requires a separate initial/final applicability decision under clause 6.3.16; unresolved criteria remain not evaluated, with no zero-demand or later-edition substitution.
Any non-passing result must carry a corrective option; spatial protection and engineering acceptance require separate evidence.

Independent generic numerical vector, installed count and self-consistent initial/final geometry.
